decision_source: explicit owner choice of option A over option B in the 0164 gate
detail: A single PUBLISHED root may hold one CAPTURED receipt per distinct consumer document/port in the P4 commit_p4_batch model, while remaining one-time CONSUMED per consumer. The legacy v1 linear chain stays single-CAPTURED-per-stream and P4/legacy capture of the same stream stay mutually exclusive.
effect: Authorizes drafting ADR-0128 (bounded multi-consumer capture correction to ADR-0127 Decision.2), which requires its own owner approval before RED. No trust.py change is authorized until the ADR is approved.
